faq.q: How long do gel nails last?
faq.a: With proper care, gel nails should last at least two weeks without chipping. We use high-quality products and proper application techniques to help them last longer. Avoid picking at them to keep them looking fresh.

We prefer bookings to guarantee your slot, but we'll do our best to fit you in if we have availability. Check our online calendar for same-day openings. Walk-ins may have to wait if we're fully booked.
Yes. Every tool is cleaned and sterilised after each client. We follow strict hygiene protocols to keep you safe. You'll see us open fresh packages for your appointment.

faq.q: What's the difference between gel and acrylic?
faq.a: Gel is a flexible, glossy polish that's cured under a lamp. Acrylic is a stronger, more durable extension that's built onto your natural nail. Gel is lighter and more natural-looking, while acrylic is better for length and strength.

faq.q: How do I make my manicure last longer?
faq.a: Wear gloves when cleaning, avoid picking at your nails, and apply cuticle oil daily. We'll show you how to care for your nails at home. The better you look after them, the longer they'll stay perfect.

blog_posts.title: How to Keep Gel Polish Lasting Longer
blog_posts.excerpt: Simple steps to make your gel manicure last weeks.
blog_posts.body:
Gel polish can stay flawless for up to three weeks if you follow a few key steps. Start by keeping your hands moisturised, dry skin causes lifting. Avoid picking at your cuticles, as this can weaken the polish bond.

When washing dishes or cleaning, wear gloves to protect your nails from harsh chemicals. These can strip the polish and make it chip faster. If you notice any lifting, book a quick fix at your salon to prevent further damage.

Finally, apply cuticle oil daily. This keeps your nails flexible and prevents cracking. A little care goes a long way in keeping your gel manicure looking fresh.

blog_posts.title: Choosing the Right Nail Shape for Your Hands
blog_posts.excerpt: Find the perfect nail shape to flatter your hands.
blog_posts.body:
The right nail shape can enhance your hands and complement your style. Almond nails suit most hand shapes, offering a soft, elegant look. If you prefer something bolder, try square or coffin shapes for a modern edge.

Short nails? Opt for rounded or squoval shapes, they make fingers appear longer. For those who love drama, stiletto nails create a striking, elongated effect. Your nail technician can help you decide based on your lifestyle and preferences.

Remember, the shape should feel comfortable for daily tasks. If you type a lot or work with your hands, shorter, rounded shapes may be more practical. A good salon will balance style and function for nails you'll love.
